title: docs(pm-dispatch): fable quota-exhaustion exemption in Model tiering
body:
Fixes #8451

## What

Writes the maintainer's quota-exhaustion ruling (2026-08-13, verbatim, untranslated: 「fable 如果用完了,可以用 opus」) into the Model tiering section of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, as one exemption subclause attached once to BOTH mandatory fable clauses (scope confirmed by the maintainer's on-card 「8451 同意」):

- **Conditional, not a new default**: only when fable is measurably unavailable (quota exhausted / rate-limited); when fable is available both clauses apply unchanged.
- **Mid-card downgrade allowed**: the wall kills mid-task rather than refusing to start, so the text says the downgrade may equally happen at re-dispatch time (墙杀在中途,重派时同样可降).
- **Floor is `opus`, never lower.**
- **Downgrade leaves a trace**: actual tier + downgrade reason recorded in the claim comment's Container & model line.

The former absolute phrase 「无向下裁量权」 is replaced by the equivalent-but-now-true framing 「两条唯一降档出口:额度耗尽豁免」 — the sole exit is named, everything else remains non-discretionary.

## Line budget (ratchet ceiling 686, file was 685 — headroom 1)

File is now exactly **686** lines (`check:pm-skill-ratchet` green, headroom 0). The section went 14 → 15 lines; the ~3 lines of new exemption text beyond the 1-line headroom were funded by these compressions **inside the Model tiering section**:

1. 「政策:」 dropped (redundant lead-in).
2. 「交付物本身是协议/流程/编排结构的最重卡,按卡取用不是新默认」 → 「最重协议/流程/编排卡,按卡取用非新默认」.
3. 「⛔ 强制条款(无向下裁量权)两条」 → 「⛔ 强制条款两条」 — absoluteness now carried by the sole-exit framing above.
4. 「失败模式是漏跑门不是判断失误」 → 「失败在漏跑门不在判断」.
5. 「—— 错在唯一契约上毒化一切下游,是全仓最贵的错误类」 → 「—— 契约错毒化一切下游,全仓最贵」.
6. 「下游适配卡(消费侧清扫)」 → 「下游适配卡」.
7. 「连同尺寸写进认领评论「Container & model」行」 → 「连同尺寸写进同一行」 — the full line name lives three lines up in the exemption clause, same paragraph.

All three pre-existing ruling quotes (2026-08-10 ×2, 2026-08-12) are preserved byte-for-byte; the paragraph was rewrapped to the file's ~96-column convention.

Per the card's region discipline, `references/**` was NOT touched (held by a parallel card this round) — the exemption is kept compact inside the section instead of adding runbook detail.
